with_snapshot.comment: lab-vendor is a local .deb: no trusted source has version 2.0, so under the judge's rules (an unconfirmed version explains none of its changed files) the upgrade is ranked as a backdoor sign. If a scan can only compare with the machine's own checksums (offline-local mode) it is explained instead; Task 21 confirms which mode the lab scans run in.
